## Where I am

The replay tool `cmd/replay` is written, with a dry run, per-partition ordering, a rejects file and a topic allowlist (`events.replay.v3` only). The dry run on the 12/11 window (14:10–17:40 UTC) finished: 18,442,107 events would be replayed, and 3,118 schema v2 lines went to the rejects file. PR #233 is open and waiting for Daniel's review. The real replay and the aggregator backfill have not been run.

- [en-cours] Waiting for Daniel's review of PR #233 before the real replay
- [prochaine-étape] Get PR #233 reviewed and merged
- [prochaine-étape] Run the real replay into `events.replay.v3` for the 12/11 window
- [prochaine-étape] Run the aggregator `--backfill` for 2026-11-12 on `events.replay.v3`
- [prochaine-étape] Give Rachel the ETA for Fernhill and Orbitly by Friday (after Daniel's review)
- [essai-raté] Dry run at `--batch 50000` was OOMKilled against the 2Gi limit (peak around 2.6 GiB); re-ran at `--batch 5000` (peak 310 MiB, completed in 19m42s). The memory limit stays untouched because of the namespace quota.
- [essai-raté] Sharing 4 workers across objects of the same hour broke per-partition order (sessionization depends on it); fixed by assigning each partition to one worker.
- [décision] Replay the whole 12/11 window, do not drop anything older than 72h; never produce directly to `events.v3` from this tool (source: t05)
- [décision] Write malformed lines to the rejects file in the bucket instead of skipping them silently (source: t15)
- [décision] Keep the 2Gi memory limit and use batches of 5k (source: t13)
- [décision] Open PR #233 ready for review with Daniel as reviewer (source: t17)
